{{Quote|I've been here two years and it's killing me. I kept thinking I'd get sold again, but I'm too old. Ce'na, you have to get me out of here.|Tivva|<ref name="MemoryTorn" />}}
'''Tivva''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who was the older sister of Ce'na, who later achieved fame under her new name as [[Vette]]. In childhood Tivva and Ce'na were sold to different masters and had no knowledge of each other for years. Tivva eventually ended up in the property of [[Toobu]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], working for him as exotic dancer on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] for over two years. Meanwhile, Vette worked as a treasure hunter, a hired [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] and was imprisoned sixteen times, the last which ended her in the company of a powerful [[Empire's Wrath|Sith Lord]]. After gaining the Sith's trust and friendship, Vette hired investigator [[Krata]] to find Tivva and eventually tracked her to [[Crystal (Twi'lek)|Crystal]], her overseer. Tivva did not recognize her sister at sight, having not seen her since childhood. After a heartwarming reunion, the Sith bought Tivva freedom and, full with joy she went her own way, promising Vette to stay in touch. She would later start seeing a Moff stationed on the Outer Rim. Tivva herself then tracked her and Vette's mother to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], only to arrive too late and find her just in time for the funeral. Vette and her Sith friend both attended, with the former unable to come to terms with her mother's passing. Tivva responded that [[Whuddle]] the Hutt was laughing about overworking their mother to death. The Sith stated that Vette would feel better with the Hutt dead at her feet, to which [[Feb'Noota]] informed them while the Sith Lord would not be able to see Whuddle due to the Hutt's fear of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], Vette and Tivva would be able to pose as dancers in order to gain access. Vette was reluctant, but the Sith Lord urged her to make Whuddle's death long and painful. After slaying the Hutt, Tivva bid Vette and her friend farewell.<ref name="Mother">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Warrior|Mother|Tatooine}}</ref>
